source.title: Grinding Them Down
source.description: We've got earth elementals coming out of our ears! Give them a proper clobbering and send them packing back to the Firelands!
source.objective: Evonice Sootsmoker wants you to slay 10 Obsidian Reavers in the Searing Gorge. The Obsidian Reavers can be found all along the southern section of Searing Gorge, and near the entrance the Blackrock Mountain.
